description: An airline loyalty newsletter: miles balance, a new-route announcement with a launch date and a lounge reopening. Travel-related, but no booking.

files.content:
SKYWARD CLUB - October newsletter

Hello Ms Tan,

Your miles balance: 38,420 miles. Your Silver status is valid until 31 March 2028.

NEW ROUTE: from 14 March 2028 Skyward flies daily from Singapore to Hanoi. Launch fares are on sale now.

LOUNGE NEWS: the Changi Terminal 3 lounge reopens on 1 December after refurbishment, with a new noodle bar.

Earn double miles on partner hotels until 30 November.

Skyward Airlines - skyward.example
